in_marathi.name: Tripurari
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tripurari हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The ruler of the three cities of the cosmos, Tripura. Tripura refers to the three cities of Maya, Vibhava, and Tripura, which are the three aspects of the god Shiva.

in_bengali.name: Tripurari
in_bengali.long_meaning: Tripurari একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The ruler of the three cities of the cosmos, Tripura. Tripura refers to the three cities of Maya, Vibhava, and Tripura, which are the three aspects of the god Shiva.
